title: Full Body Power & Core
notes: Rest 60-90s between sets. Focus on slow, controlled eccentric reps.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.instructions: Keep chest proud, feet shoulder-width apart, and squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower until chest nearly touches floor, keep core tight without arching lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge at hips with flat back. Pull towards hip pocket, squeezing shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.instructions: Hold rigid plank on forearms. Squeeze glutes and core tight without sagging lower back.
